PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2brick/>
SELECT ?z ?name ?t ?id WHERE {
  ?z a brick:Zone ; brick:hasSubclass* ?z .
  FILTER regex(str(?z), "Perimeter_mid_ZN_1|Perimeter_bot_ZN_2")
  ?z brick:hasPoint ?p ; brick:hasSubclass* ?p .
  ?p a brick:NumberOfPeople ?p .
  ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?id
}
